findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "spend_request_approval" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "cards" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: card_get_virtual, agent_register · Private data: spend_request_approval, agent_register, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine · Public sink: card_get_virtual, spend_request_approval, agent_register, payment_record, payment_history_mine.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: card_get_virtual, agent_register · Private data: spend_request_approval, agent_register, payment_record, trust_check_agent, payment_history_mine · Public sink: card_get_virtual, spend_request_approval, agent_register, payment_record, payment_history_mine

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
